Ordered (ranked) flat and nested stochastic block models

ranked_block_state.Rd

Native C++ implementation of Peixoto's (2022) flat and nested ordered (ranked) stochastic block models for directed networks, matching graph-tool's RankedBlockState and NestedBlockState(base_state = RankedBlockState). Jointly infers community assignments and an ordinal ranking of groups that explains global directional flow (upstream, lateral, and downstream edges).

Usage

ranked_block_state(graph, blocks = NULL, u = NULL, distance = FALSE,
  unique = FALSE, M = NULL, degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"))
ranked_description_length(state, label_dl = TRUE, degree_prior = NULL)
minimize_ranked_blockmodel_dl(graph, distance = FALSE, unique = FALSE,
  M = NULL, degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"), B_min = 1L, B_max = Inf,
  refine = TRUE, epsilon = 1e-3)
nested_ranked_block_state(graph, levels = NULL, u = NULL, distance = FALSE,
  unique = FALSE, M = NULL, degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"))
nested_ranked_level_entropy(state, degree_prior = NULL)
nested_ranked_description_length(state, degree_prior = NULL)
minimize_nested_ranked_blockmodel_dl(graph, distance = FALSE, unique = FALSE,
  M = NULL, degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"), B_min = 1L, B_max = Inf,
  refine = TRUE, epsilon = 1e-3)
ranked_vertex_order(state, normalize = FALSE)
ranked_edge_directions(state)
ranked_edge_counts(state)
compare_ordered_models(graph,
  models = c("unordered_flat", "unordered_nested",
    "ranked_flat", "ranked_nested"),
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  method = c("map", "posterior"),
  evidence_method = c("variational", "importance"),
  nruns = 1L, nsamples = 200L, thin = 5L, burnin = NULL, mle = TRUE,
  B_min = 1L, B_max = Inf, refine = TRUE)

Arguments

graph

A directed graph created by graph_create with directed = TRUE.

blocks

Optional integer vector of 1-based group memberships of length graph_num_vertices(graph). Defaults to a single group.

levels

Optional list of at least two 1-based integer group membership vectors defining a nested hierarchy over the directed graph.

u

Optional finite integer vector of length at least \(B\) assigning each level-0 group an ordinal rank. Defaults to 0:(B - 1).

distance

If FALSE (the default), edge orientation probabilities depend only on whether \(u_r < u_s\), \(u_r = u_s\), or \(u_r > u_s\); if TRUE, edge orientation counts are stratified by rank distance \(|u_r - u_s|\).

unique

If FALSE (the default), multiple groups may share the same rank drawn from \(\{0, \dots, M - 1\}\); if TRUE, all groups have strictly distinct ranks.

M

Size of the discrete rank alphabet when unique = FALSE. Defaults to the number of vertices \(N\).

degree_corrected

Whether to fit the degree-corrected (TRUE) or non-degree-corrected (FALSE) ranked SBM.

degree_prior

Degree sequence hyperprior ("distributed" or "uniform").

state

A flat rgraphtool_ranked_block_state or nested rgraphtool_nested_ranked_block_state object.

label_dl

Whether to include the rank-label prior term \(\ln \binom{M + B - 1}{B}\) (when unique = FALSE).

B_min, B_max

Minimum and maximum number of level-0 occupied groups.

refine

Whether to run greedy refinement and rank-optimization sweeps after merge-split minimization.

epsilon

Stopping tolerance in nats for greedy refinement.

normalize

If TRUE, rescale vertex ranks to \([0, 1]\).

models

Character vector naming a subset of "unordered_flat", "unordered_nested", "ranked_flat", "ranked_nested", "ranked_distance_flat", and "ranked_distance_nested".

method

Compare models by "map" minimum description length or full Bayesian "posterior" marginal evidence.

evidence_method

Evidence estimator forwarded to model_evidence when method = "posterior".

nruns

Number of independent minimization restarts per model.

nsamples, thin, burnin, mle

Posterior sampling and entropy estimation controls forwarded to model_evidence.

Details

In the ranked SBM, the undirected multigraph of edge counts \(m_{rs} = e_{rs} + e_{sr}\) is generated by an undirected SBM (or an undirected nested hierarchy at levels \(l \ge 1\)), while edge orientations between groups \(r\) and \(s\) are governed by their relative ranks \(u_r\) and \(u_s\). When distance = FALSE, minimization canonicalizes distinct group ranks into contiguous integers \(0, \dots, K-1\) oriented so that upstream edges (\(u_r < u_s\)) outnumber downstream edges (\(u_r > u_s\)) without altering the exact description length.

Flat and nested ranked states integrate with block_membership, block_sizes, nested_levels, nested_project, nested_summary, mcmc_sweep, mcmc_equilibrate, mcmc_anneal, sample_posterior, model_evidence, plot_ranked_hierarchy, and plot_hierarchy.

Value

ranked_block_state() and minimize_ranked_blockmodel_dl() return a rgraphtool_ranked_block_state list. nested_ranked_block_state() and minimize_nested_ranked_blockmodel_dl() return a rgraphtool_nested_ranked_block_state list.

ranked_description_length() and nested_ranked_description_length() return total description lengths in nats; nested_ranked_level_entropy() returns per-level contributions.

ranked_vertex_order() returns a numeric vector of per-vertex ranks. ranked_edge_directions() returns an integer vector with 1L (upstream, \(u_i < u_j\)), 0L (lateral, \(u_i = u_j\)), and -1L (downstream, \(u_i > u_j\)) for every edge. ranked_edge_counts() returns a list with counts upstream, lateral, downstream, and internal.

compare_ordered_models() returns a rgraphtool_ordered_model_comparison list with ranked summary, best_model, best_state, states, optional evidences, and log_bayes_factors.

References

Peixoto, T. P. (2022). Ordered community structure in networks. Physical Review E 106, 024305. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.106.024305

See also

plot_ranked_hierarchy, plot_hierarchy, mcmc_sweep, model_evidence, demo("ordered_sbm")

Examples

set.seed(1)
tier <- rep(1:3, each = 5L)
ed <- list()
for (i in 1:15) for (j in 1:15) if (i != j) {
  p <- if (tier[i] == tier[j]) 0.7 else if (tier[j] > tier[i]) 0.35 else 0.02
  if (runif(1) < p) ed[[length(ed) + 1L]] <- c(i, j)
}
g <- graph_add_edges(graph_create(15, directed = TRUE), do.call(rbind, ed))
st <- minimize_ranked_blockmodel_dl(g)
st
#> <ranked block state: degree-corrected, B = 3, 20 upstream / 43 lateral / 1 downstream, DL = 159.3705 nats>
ranked_edge_counts(st)
#> $upstream
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $lateral
#> [1] 43
#> 
#> $downstream
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $internal
#> [1] 43
#>
